messages:
Maya (PM): BigRetail wants to onboard a fine-tuned Llama sha and asks for a 3-month pin. Requirements: p95 <=120ms @512, and rerank parity with our reference. Can we scope an onramp + pin approach?
Raj (Eng): We can, but need their eval set and a short traffic dump. If it's fp16 quantized we'll likely need a kernel perf pass. Also verify KV cache semantics for long chats.
Sam (CSE): Asking for 48h sample and a 2000-query eval subset now. Customer said they'd tolerate a 2-week grace migration.
Ana (ML): Proposed gates: (1) rerank within 2% of baseline; (2) NER hallucination <= baseline; (3) latency p95 <=1.3x of our verified profile; (4) embedding cosine delta <0.02. Fail any = block.
Leo (SRE): Hard pin implies reserved Dedicated pool and ops overhead. Need rollback SLA and a canary calendar slot. Soft pin can fallback under overload.
Raj (Eng): Pin policy sketch: soft-pin = route preferred sha but allow fallback; hard-pin = reserved route -> always sha. Default soft unless reserved capacity paid.
Maya (PM): Negotiation plan: offer 90d soft pin + migration plan; push for reserved commit to upgrade to hard pin. Sam to negotiate.
Sam (CSE): Customer prefers predictability; likely to accept 90d soft pin if we provide transparent migration path and API stability guarantees. I'll push for reserve discount too.
Ana (ML): I'll run the onramp suite: QA exact-match, rerank AUC, perplexity on domain, latency measurements. ETA 48h. Gate behavior: quality block on fail; latency warn at 1.3x and block at 1.5x.
Raj (Eng): I'll add perf metadata to catalog: {model_sha, quant, fp_type, p95_512, memory_gb, kv_cache_notes}. Can prototype API flag pin_ttl/pin_type by EOD.
Leo (SRE): Rollout plan: 5% for 6h -> 25% for 12h -> 100% with monitors (latency_p95, rerank_delta, 5xx). Auto-rollback if rerank drift >2% or 5xx spike >0.5%.
Maya (PM): Action items: Ana run eval (48h), Raj add perf matrix and kernel check (48h), Leo reserve tentative pool and block canary slot (3bd), Sam negotiate and collect eval data (24h).
Raj (Eng): Example rollout config:
```
rollout:
  - pct: 5; duration: 6h; monitors: [latency_p95, rerank_delta, error_rate]
  - pct: 25; duration: 12h; monitors: [latency_p95, rerank_delta]
  - pct: 100; duration: 24h; monitors: [latency_p95, rerank_delta]
fallback_policy: soft_fallback: true
```
Maya (PM): Pin rules summary: hard pin requires reserved capacity + signed SLA. Soft pin = 90d TTL + weekly eval reports. >90d requires exec signoff.
Ana (ML): Safety addendum: If production prompts show regression even when offline tests pass, trigger emergency rollback and a production audit.
deploy-bot: Canary scheduled for 1796660900 (5% traffic) 1 will post alerts to #eng-runtime during the window.
Maya (PM): Decision: proceed with 90d soft pin, run onramp and canary, offer reserved capacity to upgrade to hard pin within 14 days. Owners: Maya (track), Raj (routing). Thanks, team :thumbsup:
